feedback: Iteration 4's 7-sensor symmetric array with 0.016 m sensor size and 0.16 m wheel track improved coverage and reduced line loss events but still failed to finish the slalom track, with moderate steering oscillation and high control effort. If the next race shows reduced line loss events and lower rms_error, continue refining sensor positions with slight lateral shifts within ±0.01 m to optimize coverage. If steering oscillation remains high, consider increasing wheel track up to 0.17 m to improve stability. If progress or completion rates remain low, try reducing mass to 0.65 kg to enhance acceleration and finish rates. These suggestions are based on iteration 3 and 4 evidence showing benefits of increased sensor count and size but persistent challenges on complex tracks.
